name: Halftone Image Hover
description: Turn any image into a halftone of dots that scatter around the cursor and drift back, in React. WebGL renders every dot in one draw call, so it stays smooth with tens of thousands of dots. Repel or attract, swirl, grow, dot shapes, hex grid, image colours, plus all the tone controls.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Remote hosts must send CORS headers (Unsplash, Cloudinary and your own /public do). Transparent areas get no dots.

props.name: mode
props.description: 'light' puts dots on bright areas, 'dark' on dark ones (use dark for photos on a light background).

props.name: threshold
props.description: Tone (0–100) below which no dot is drawn. Raise it to drop the background.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Contrast applied to the image before it's turned into dots.

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Largest dot radius, in px.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between dots, in px. Smaller = finer and more dots.

props.name: variation
props.description: Random size jitter, so the pattern doesn't look mechanical.

props.name: grid
props.description: Square grid, or every other row shifted half a step (print-like).

props.name: shape
props.description: Dot shape.

props.name: colorMode
props.description: 'mono' uses primaryColor with a share of accentColor; 'image' gives every dot the image's own colour.

props.name: primaryColor
props.description: Main dot colour (mono).

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Accent dot colour (mono).

props.name: accentAmount
props.description: Share of dots in the accent colour, 0–1.

props.name: effect
props.description: 'repel' pushes dots away from the pointer, 'attract' pulls them in.

props.name: radius
props.description: Pointer reach, in px.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far dots move, in px.

props.name: swirl
props.description: Sideways twist around the pointer, -1 to 1.

props.name: grow
props.description: Dots under the pointer grow by this factor (0 = no change).

props.name: ease
props.description: How fast dots follow and return, 0–1 per 60fps frame. Lower = floatier.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the image fills the box.

props.name: imageScale
props.description: Extra zoom on the image.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall dot opacity.

props.name: background
props.description: Background colour.

props.name: transparent
props.description: Draw no background, so the dots sit over whatever is behind.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a size.
